svg.title: How an AI agent plays Minecraft — MineTrials
svg.desc: An external model and agent harness connect over MCP to the MineTrials meta-harness. System 2, thinking slow, runs agent-authored Python with game primitives. System 1, thinking fast, runs editable reflexes that can preempt actions without a model call. The Fabric bridge controls Minecraft via Baritone and native game interactions. State, events and screenshot images return to the agent over MCP.
